selection: All22reported patients, first numbered section only; GEO title-based before expression values/outcomes
M0: Frozen C4 primary ResNet18 D1 three-seed ensemble reused unchanged from C9
M1: Exact C9 interpolation: up to16 nearest anchors; normalized inverse-distance power2 V1, unweighted mean16 V2. No cross-patient fitting or calibration.
M2: Omitted from metric tables; optional affine equivalence checked each inference. No distinct interpolation gain claimed.
M3: Exact C9 prediction rule and already-frozen C9 T1 scaler:0.2 calibrated frozen image+0.8 ST; source moments NCBI783/NCBI785, destination moments Wu1142243F/CID4465/CID4535. No C10 labels fit any scaler or weight. Transport of that frozen calibration is secondary, not a C10 calibration experiment.
regular_sampling_label: V3 in requested plan means secondary sampling policy; stored as strategy=spatial_FPS alongside V1/V2 to avoid conflating policy with mask geometry
masks: Exact C7/C9 policy: nested random permutations or deterministic farthest-pointXY; floor(N*budget+.5) anchors. V1 scores all unobserved. V2 forbids nearest40%locations around25/50/75% PC1rank centers, chooses anchors outside and scores forbiddenregion only. Other unobserved values also excluded.
count_preprocessing: Finite nonnegative integer counts from provided filtered10xH5, source in_tissue flag; log1p then unchanged C0training gene mean/SD; no C10 library-size/area/target normalization fitted
image_preprocessing: Unchanged112um nominal square, rounded native pixels/top-left, LANCZOS224RGB, official ResNet18 IMAGENET1K_V1 transform/weights
coordinate_preprocessing: Barcode join; micrometers from source hexagonal100um lattice least-squares pixel transform; no expression-dependent registration
metrics: Same frozen C9 Pearson/Spearman/MSE/MAE; hidden locations only; means/medians per gene, Pearson thresholds0/.1/.2/.3. Undefined correlations excluded from correlation summary; counted as not passing threshold. Raw rank metrics retain floating-point-tie limitations.
aggregation: Mean over seeds within geometry, equal geometry mean per patient/coverage/regime/policy; headline median of patient metrics. Patient biological unit; no spot-pseudoreplicated inference. Primary20%V1random,10/40%support.

controls.definitions: Exact C9 anchor-vector permutation, anchor-position assignment permutation, image-prediction permutation. NC1/NC2 related association nulls.

pass_criteria.meaningful_ST: M1-M0 median Pearson>=.02 AND relative mean MSE reduction>=.02 AND MAE no worse
pass_criteria.PASS: At least ceil(2N/3) patients meaningful at>=2/3V1random budgets; positive median Pearson/MSE/MAE benefit at every budget; at least ceil(2N/3) have Pearson40>10 and MSE40<10. Distance curves characterized honestly, allV2 reported, controls and technical audits complete.
pass_criteria.LIMITED: Same scientific support but qualification limited by input resolution/platform/patient count. Limited H&E qualification cannot yield unrestricted PASS.
pass_criteria.MIXED: PASScriteria not met but at least2patients meaningful at any budget.
pass_criteria.TECHNICAL: Any hidden-label dependence, replay mismatch, parent hash change or identity failure.
pass_criteria.fusion_secondary: At least ceil(2N/3) patients improve Pearson,MSE,MAE at>=2budgets and<=25%patient-budget settings have MSE harm>2%; not required for STpass.
pass_criteria.distance: Perpatient/regime curves with counts and >=20location correlation rule; no forced horizon or posthocbin changes.
pass_criteria.V2: Report paired matched-budget protocol degradation including different frozen interpolationfamily and scoringgeometry; do not call this a geometry-only causal effect.

secondary_S2_280: Overlap recorded; optional evaluation omitted to prioritize primary replication and manuscript provenance
manuscript: No new scientific models/statisticaltests; descriptive aggregation of frozen sources; distinguish40/50panels and roles; exactsourceledger; negative findings retained
